messages.author: 8caaa59b59ca3bd1
messages.subject: importing as.telemetry and specifying UERE
parts:
Hi there,

I am importing my GPS data and specifying UERE=30 because my GPS data does not contain satellite error estimates for each location, but I can be confident that the error won't exceed 30 meters. I get a series of errors for certain individuals (pasted below).  In particular, I get the following error:

"In telemetry.clean(telist[[i]], id = id[i]) :
  Times might be out of order or duplicated in R13. Make sure that timeformat and timezone are correctly specified."

I have examined the data manually and cannot find duplicates and the timezone is UTC.  I initially imported the data in Movebank format. The timezone is UTC and the timestamp format is in POSIXct.

I was hoping someone might be able to shed some light on this? 

Many thanks,
Luke

messages.author: 40fd627580dd34f5
messages.subject: Re: importing as.telemetry and specifying UERE
parts:
Hi Luke,

Have you tried supplying a timeformat argument? I find that as.POSIXct() in R often needs help translating character timestamps, even when the format seems obvious. Its behavior also seems to change between R versions (if a timeformat argument isn't supplied).

Best,
Chris
